resources.string: Control agents can open any installed applet\'s portal on this screen, read what it shows and use the functions it offers, just as you would by touch.
This applet or its page is no longer available.
A control agent is using this page
A control agent just used this page

Control agents can change the money limits of an installed applet, top one up for this period, or change how often its checks run. Within the ceiling you set, at most 10 changes a day; you get a notice.
Where applets can send messages and photos: Home Assistant, Discord, ntfy, Telegram, n8n and other webhooks.
Send messages, data and photos to the webhooks you approved in Applets › Connections (Home Assistant, Discord, ntfy, Telegram, n8n…). Control agents never see their addresses or secrets.
An applet keeps its own small records on the phone (for example the items of an inventory). Nothing is uploaded; removing the applet deletes them.
Control agents can ask to install an applet package. You review what it uses and how often on one screen; nothing runs until you approve it.
Control agents hand over a list of actions with times once; the phone runs them by itself after you approve. Review in Files and Android access → Scheduled actions.

A control agent can give the phone a list of actions and when to run them, such as a photo every 7 minutes or a sound at 7:30. You approve each new list once; then the phone runs it without the control agent, using only the access that control agent already has.
Scheduled actions are switched off in Feature enablement, so nothing runs.
No control agent has scheduled anything.
Paused. Nothing runs until you resume.
Approving replaces the list that is running now. Any later change comes back here for approval.
Remove %1$s\'s scheduled actions and saved files?
Tap to review. Nothing runs until you approve.
The phone\'s mode (home, away, night, vacation or one you add). Applets can read it, start flows when it changes and, with your approval, set it.
Choose a mode for this phone. Applets can use it to decide when to run.
Use letters, numbers, spaces, or underscores.
Mode names can be at most 24 characters.
A mode with this name already exists.
